title: wildmat: pattern parser and matcher (RFC 3977 §4.1)
description:
## Why
Needed by stoa-efbe068a. `matches_wildmat` already exists in `crates/reader/src/session/commands/list.rs` but is private to the reader crate. Move it to `stoa-core` so both reader (LIST ACTIVE filtering) and transit ([groups] names matching) share one implementation.

## What
- Move `wildmat_match` and `matches_wildmat` from `crates/reader/src/session/commands/list.rs` into `crates/core/src/wildmat.rs` (or `crates/core/src/util.rs`)
- Add `pub fn wildmat_list_match(patterns: &[WildmatPattern], name: &str) -> bool` — evaluate an ordered list with `!`-prefixed negation; first match wins; returns false if no pattern matches
- Add `pub struct WildmatPattern { pub negated: bool, pub pattern: String }` and a `FromStr` impl
- Update reader to import from `stoa_core` instead of the local private function
- All existing reader wildmat tests continue to pass unchanged
